en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.211 - Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) that He said:
I asked him about a woman who experiences labor pains for one or two days or more and sees yellowish discharge or blood. What should She do regarding prayer?
Imam (as) said: 'She should pray as long as She has not given birth. If the pain overwhelms her, She should pray when She recovers.'.
